summary: Client 1 read 2 (op 2) and then read 1 (op 3); the second read sees a value that was overwritten before the first read.

conflicts.why: Within a single client (client 1), op 2 returned 2 (the post-op-1 state) but op 3, started later, returned 1 (the pre-op-1 state). State cannot move backwards from a client's perspective.

suggestions: Check for client routing that fails over to a stale replica between requests
Check for read-your-writes session guarantees being violated
